brief:
Nearly 400 settlers entered Al-Aqsa mosque under protection from Israeli occupation forces and performed Talmudic rituals and provocative dances in its courtyards, Shehab Wire reported. The incursion occurred as authorities tightened restrictions on Palestinian worshippers' entry and confiscated their identification documents at the gates.

The raid is part of a pattern of settler access to the holy site that Palestinians and rights groups say violates the mosque's sanctity and the status quo governing the compound.

title: 398 settlers storm Al-Aqsa mosque in occupied Jerusalem
